query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN family IS NOT NULL AND family != '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as with_family,
  COUNT(DISTINCT family) as unique_families,
  COUNT(DISTINCT genus) as unique_genera
FROM plants;
